Hi,

Sorry for the confusion on my submission setup.

The CI error appears to be due to a mismatch between the submission directory expected by the workflow and the directory currently included in my PR.

The workflow attempted to evaluate:

./submissions/optimization_qpose_josema

and failed with:

ERROR: ./submissions/optimization_qpose_josema/inflate.sh not found

My submission files are currently located under:

./submissions/optimization_qpose

That directory contains the required files:

- archive.zip
- inflate.sh
- inflate.py
- report.txt

So the error was not caused by inflate.sh failing during evaluation, but by the workflow looking for it in a different directory name than the one included in my PR.

Apologies again for the confusion. I wanted to clarify the cause of the failure so it is clear that this was a path/directory mismatch rather than a runtime failure of the submission itself.

Best,  
Jose
